verdict.rationale: Logseq is described as a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base whose graphs can stay local-only. Publishing produces a static SPA you can host yourself. Community users report source availability, keeping graphs in their own git repos, and self-hosting knowledge graphs for a team. Missing for 10: a first-party self-hosting/deployment guide (e.g., for a web or server build), a self-hostable alternative to the vendor-run Logseq Sync, and explicit license/build-from-source documentation.
